column1: # Hand-maintained festival extension (PLANNING 5a).
# The `holidays` package covers the national list and the state subdivisions
# configured in calendar.subdivisions
# (Diwali
# This file is for what it misses.
# RULE FOR ANYONE EDITING THIS FILE
#   Dates are lunar and move every year. Enter them from an authoritative
#   source only. Never derive one from another festival
#   never guess. A wrong date here is invisible: it mislabels is_holiday for
#   that day and the model quietly learns the wrong effect.
# PARTIAL VERIFIED COVERAGE
#   The 2024/2025 Shashthi through Navami dates below come from Government
#   of West Bengal holiday notifications
#   https://wbpar.gov.in/writereaddata/holiday/6112-F(P2).pdf
#   https://wb.gov.in/pdf/Holiday-2025.pdf
#   Earlier years and 2026 remain unverified; this is not an exhaustive list.
# REMAINING GAPS
#   Durga Puja (IN-EA). Four to five days in Sep/Oct in which West Bengal
#   substantially shuts down - plausibly the largest single demand event in
#   that zone. The package carries Dussehra
#   LAST day; the preceding Shashthi through Navami days are absent. The
#   window could be derived from the Dussehra date
#   exactly what the rule above forbids
#   Others likely missing: Chhath (IN-NO/IN-EA)
# Columns: date (YYYY-MM-DD
date
